recognize_zh: 腎絲球明顯分葉、細胞增生，銀染色（黑色基底膜）下微血管壁增厚並呈雙軌（double contour/tram-track）樣，伴隨系膜與內皮下增生，就是膜增生性腎絲球腎炎（MPGN）型態；本圖實為銀染色而非 H&E。
features: Enlarged glomerulus with marked lobular accentuation
Mesangial and endocapillary hypercellularity with narrowed capillary lumens
Silver-positive (black) glomerular basement membranes with duplication/double contours
Intact Bowman capsule; surrounding tubules and interstitium with mild inflammation
describe_en: Renal biopsy section shows an enlarged, hypercellular glomerulus with accentuated lobular architecture due to mesangial and endocapillary proliferation, with narrowing of capillary lumens. The silver stain highlights thickened glomerular capillary walls with basement membrane duplication (double contours), and occasional pale intracapillary deposits are present. Although labeled H&E, the black basement membranes indicate a methenamine silver (Jones) stain. Findings represent a membranoproliferative pattern of glomerular injury; in CLL, this is commonly due to cryoglobulin or monoclonal immunoglobulin deposition, and immunofluorescence and electron microscopy are required to classify it.

ddx.vs: Chronic TMA also shows GBM double contours but lacks immune deposits and marked mesangial hypercellularity, with negative immunofluorescence.
C3 glomerulopathy can have an MPGN pattern but shows dominant C3 staining with little or no immunoglobulin, whereas paraprotein-related MPGN shows restricted IgG/IgM with a single light chain.
Diabetic Kimmelstiel-Wilson nodules are acellular, silver-positive laminated mesangial nodules without endocapillary hypercellularity or double contours.
Lupus shows full-house immunofluorescence and wire-loop deposits, and requires clinical/serologic SLE.
